plainText:
Masakazu Morita (Japanese: 森田成一 Morita Masakazu) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Morita was born on October 21, 1972, in , ; and he became an actor, voice actor, and singer as an adult. He was affiliated with the talent agency and was well-known for a number of roles in several anime series. Morita provided his voice for Chili, one of the three Striaton City Gym Leaders and brothers, in .
